title: Multifunctional carbon-modified MoS2 with expanded interlayer spacing and multiple exposed sulfur active sites for high-capacity Hg(II) adsorption
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,38069-38081
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04594K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Mingmin Bai, Wenyuan Guo, Yiyang Zhang, Ruiqiang Yang, Weixin Li
A novel multifunctional carbon-modified MoS2 material was synthesized through a solvothermal method, exhibiting expanded interlayer spacing and abundant exposed sulfur active sites that enabled efficient adsorption of Hg2+ from wastewater.
